call_points.text: Management expressed confidence in delivering sustainable long-term growth supported by compliance track record and product pipeline.
Witnessed broad-based growth across all product categories and geographies in Q2FY27.
Launched new dermatology division, Inspira, expanding presence into dermatology portfolio.
Successfully completed USFDA inspection at Unit II formulation facility in Valthera with one minor observation unrelated to GMP.
Company approved a 1:1 bonus share issue, reflecting confidence in sustained profitability and future earnings potential.
Margins were lower on account of higher input costs and change in product mix.
FY27 growth guided above historical rates, with visibility into coming quarters.
40% EBITDA margin now seen in FY28, not within FY27.
API capacity addition decision when Unit 3 utilisation reaches 80–85%; only 20–25% of 160 acres used.
CDMO currently 1–2% of sales; target double-digit, with one project commercialised and one more expected this year.
Injectable facility can do close to ₹600 Cr top line; external sales expected in H2FY27.
Gross margin 78.9%, up 100 bps on pricing discipline and favourable mix.
Zero-debt balance sheet with over ₹442 Cr cash; Q1 capex about ₹9.5 Cr.
Injectable ramp-up was delayed by a couple of quarters last year on inspections and facility qualification.
ANDA approvals from U.S. FDA for mycophenolate mofetil and Tofacitinib tablets received in the quarter.

guidance.statement: We expect FY27 growth to be slightly better off than our historical growth of around 18%.

Unit 1 capacity utilisation about 80%, Unit 3 about 55%, Unit 2 about 25% and injectables about 5% in Q1FY27.
CDMO is currently 1–2% of sales; one animal-health project is commercialised with a couple of million dollars of sales.
Injectable facility can do close to ₹600 Cr of top line; external sales expected in H2FY27 and emerging-market sales by next year.
Launched new dermatology division, Inspira, expanding presence into dermatology segment.

timeline.summary: Concord Biotech promoter Sudhir Vaid submitted the annual Regulation 31(4) disclosure reporting a 44.08% stake with zero encumbrance as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹326.08 Cr (-24.1% YoY), net profit ₹88.47 Cr.
Concord Biotech Limited hosted earnings call recording for Q4FY26 on June 1, 2026, available at https://concordbiotech.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Concord-Q4FY26-EC-Audio.mp3.
Concord Biotech secured USFDA approval for Mycophenolate Mofetil for Oral Suspension USP, 200 mg/mL, targeting a USD 30M U.S. market.
Concord Biotech hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on June 1, 2026, highlighting strong H1 visibility and expected growth recovery in FY27.

On its 3 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Concord Biotech reported revenue of ₹257 Cr (+26% YoY) and PAT of ₹58 Cr (+31%), guided FY27 growth above historical rates and pushed the 40% EBITDA margin target to FY28.
Voting results of September 23, 2026 postal ballot show 2 ordinary resolutions passed, including amendment of MOA and issuance of bonus equity shares, effective 24-10-2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹309.07 Cr (+25.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹70.65 Cr (+11.1% YoY) (Q2FY26 includes ₹2.29 Cr from discontinued operations).
Concord Biotech reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹309.1 Cr and PAT of ₹69.6 Cr, and announced a 1:1 bonus share issue.
